summary: Configure one evidence-backed SPI master bus and create an explicit full-duplex HAL transfer module.
requires: A validated board profile whose MCU matches the new project.
Three manual-evidenced, available board pins for SCK, MISO, and MOSI, including voltage, attached-device, routing, and reservation constraints.
A cited target-device requirement for SPI clock polarity/phase, maximum clock rate, bit order, frame size, and chip-select strategy.
The selected MCU's local CubeMX SPI mode XML for the exact instance, Full_Duplex_Master mode, SCK/MISO/MOSI signals, and approved parameters.
verifications: Verify the generated .ioc assigns the planned SCK, MISO, and MOSI signals.
Verify generated main.c initializes the intended SPI handle with the approved master, clock polarity/phase, prescaler, data-size, and NSS settings.
Compile the project after module integration.
